question: What is the ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM customers

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T2.currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T2.currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM 
    transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN 
    customers AS T2 ON T1.customerid = T2.customerid
final_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T2.currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T2.currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM 
    transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN 
    customers AS T2 ON T1.customerid = T2.customerid

question: What are the atoms of the triple bond with the molecule "TR041"?

SELECT t.trans_id, t.date, t.amount 
FROM trans t 
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id 
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id 
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id 
WHERE c.client_id = 3356 AND t.operation = 'VYBER'
